description: 한국 여행 안내·관광 통계 (Korea Basics): Find places in Korea from the Korea Basics map: by region, month or season, theme (palaces, national parks, museums, UNESCO sites, temples, night views, beaches, autumn leaves, cherry blossoms), accessibility needs (step-free, wheelchair rental, stroller, nursing room), a drama, film or artist filmed there, or nearness to another place (within about 3 km). A whole sentence works as the query. Returns up to 10 places, each with its English and Korean name, which public list it is on (for example Korea 100 or the Seoul night view spots), admission figures where they exist, how many photos the site has, whether a live view exists, and the map URL. Covers sights, culture and leisure; it does not rate restaurants or hotels.

has.description: Optional. "photos" and/or "live" to keep only places with photo sets or a live view.

near.description: Optional. A place id or name; returns places within about 3 km of it.

query.description: Optional. Free words or a sentence, e.g. "palaces in Seoul with wheelchair access", "cherry blossoms in April", "경주 가볼 만한 곳".

region.description: Optional. Province, city or district name, e.g. "Seoul", "Busan", "Jeju", "Jongno-gu", "서울".

tags.description: Optional. Conditions such as "wheelchair", "stroller", "night view", "free entry", "beach".

work.description: Optional. A drama, film or artist filmed at the place, e.g. "Squid Game", "BTS".

name: find_korea_places
title: Find places to go
